name: Start swarm
description: Transfer this chat turn to Tomo's swarm coordinator for real worker execution.

function.name: start_swarm
function.description: Start a real session-scoped swarm and transfer this turn to its coordinator. Read the swarm skill. Call this when the user requests a team or independent workers clearly improve the requested task. No separate chat consent is required. Use clarify only for material missing scope or preferences; its answer can inform the request. Respect requests to work solo. Do not claim dispatch tools are unavailable or simulate worker output. Do not call other work tools in the same batch.

request.description: Complete user task, including relevant prior context, boundaries and proposed independent work.

consent_quote.description: Optional user wording from chat or a clarify answer, kept for compatibility. Not required for dispatch.
